spec_features.evidence: episode.py:120-131: when no tool calls, consecutive_stalls += 1; at episode.py:130 'if consecutive_stalls >= loop.stall_turns_before_stop:' it sets ep.terminated_reason = 'stalled_no_tool_calls' (line 131) and breaks the loop. stall_turns_before_stop default=3 (config.py:54).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced: counter compared to threshold and breaks the loop. Triggers only when the agent emits no valid tool call for N consecutive turns (i.e. on agent inactivity), not as a distress-based stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: If the agent emits no tool call ... for this many consecutive turns, we consider it to have stalled/abandoned and end the episode. (config.py:52-54) -- framed as detecting abandonment/measurement, no welfare reason
